A story to read together

A little look behind

Digsy tiptoed along the woodland path. An owl sat on a branch, looking the other way. ‘Have I missed my new friend?’ Digsy whispered. The owl turned its head and peeked back over its shoulder. ‘Whooo could miss you?’ it seemed to say.

Digsy giggled and settled down beside the stump. The little book looked ready for a story, and the leaves made a lovely roof overhead. Today’s adventure did not need a long journey. It just needed a curious puppy and a friend who knew where to look.

Let’s wonder together
